output.title: Unclear whether cert-manager runs with --namespace flag
output.content: The change only matters if cert-manager controllers run with `--namespace=<namespace>`. The environment summary lists values keys such as global.leaderElection.namespace, but none that sets that flag, and values coverage is only "partial". The Deployment manifests' container args and any extraArgs are not shown, so use of the flag cannot be confirmed or ruled out. The operator should check the cert-manager controller args (Helm values or the Deployment) for `--namespace`.
